rationale: Setup binds at ss/100C max-RC; hold, slew/cap (0 vs bar 295) and DRC stay clean. At 8.59 ns repair idles (+1.0-1.3 ns slack), so T_eff is natural delay; orfs plus slew 40 cut it from ~7.5 to 7.27. Untested lead: blabla's reg-to-reg delay was 6.62 ns (orfs, slew 39) and y_huff's 7.49 with stock RC; both had timing-driven placement off, routability on, ABC buffering/sizing on (md5 shows buffering/sizing alone neutral). Their T_eff was port-limited only because I/O delay scales with loose targets, so TPE rates these knobs poorly and won't try them. Replicate blabla's combination at the tightest target; TPE already favours post-GRT timing repair and ~0.3 margins, keeping re-runs robust.
